IssueStep.description:
Step of the issue cycle, in order. The identifier of a step is its spelling in the contract: in the ledger, in hand-overs and in the JSON output of every channel, a `snake_case` value as every enum value of the contract (ADR 0009 C4, SPEC-0001), with one spelling everywhere. Other spellings, such as the kebab-case labels of a tracker, are produced by the adapters from it; the core never spells them.

- `claim`: The issue is assigned to one agent session and labelled as in progress.
- `reanalysis`: The agent re-reads the issue, its story, its specification and the code involved.
- `counter_review`: A second agent looks for gaps, edge cases and contradictions.
- `checklist`: The task checklist is generated from the specification and published on the issue.
- `build`: Tests where they pay, then the code.
- `verify`: Deterministic checks decide whether the step succeeded.
- `review`: Review proportional to risk.
- `pull_request`: The pull request is open and linked to the issue.
- `merge`: Approval state: only a person merges.

Ruling.description: A ruling of a session (SPEC-0003 R5): a decision the agent took, why, and what it costs if it is wrong.

cost_if_wrong.description: What it costs to undo if it proves wrong.

description: A hand-over record (SPEC-0001, Hand-over record): the input of the agent with the members the engine sets, as the engine records it.

branch.description: Branch of the checkout, valid under the naming grammar of SPEC-0001 R11.

executor.description: Executor that ran the session, for example `claude_code`.

files_touched.description: Project paths changed by the session; `[]` means none.

items.description: Path of a repository file relative to the root of the project, in one spelling: segments joined by `/`, none empty, `.` or `..`; no leading `/`, no `\` and no drive letter, so that it never leaves the project.

id.description: Stable identifier, in the canonical form of the type; assigned by the engine and never reused (SPEC-0001 R2, R14).

issue.description: Tracker number of the issue worked, from the checkout.

language.description: Language of the prose, a BCP 47 tag; when absent, the language of the project.

next_step.description: First action of the next session.

items.description: A prose text of at least one character, in the language of the document.
A prose text of at least one character, in the language of the document.

recorded_at.description: When the engine recorded the hand-over.

rulings.description: Rulings of the session; `[]` means none.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema of the type the document was written against (SPEC-0001 R16).

step.description: Step reached in the issue cycle.

task.description: Task of the issue, when it has one; it carries the same `issue`.

tokens.description: Size of the record in tokens, from 1: the length in bytes of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the record without the member `tokens`, divided by four, rounded up, so that the count never depends on itself; counted by the engine, within the budget of SPEC-0003 R12.
